milestones.title: CI diagnosis and repair
milestones.summary: The owner accepted the bounded Phase 3 proof on 15 October 2026. Hosted results include a verified narrow repair published as an exact draft PR, an owner-performed merge, and an infrastructure diagnosis without source changes. The uncertain-report outcome was accepted.
limitations: Successful intermittent-failure classification remains unqualified. The comparison retained Unknown because execution conditions differed.
The proof used owner-started workflows, one controlled application profile, and a deterministic repair. It does not qualify live-model or general autonomous remediation.
Retained-state replay checks were local. No new SDK verification of the merged product commit or deployment is claimed.

milestones.title: Alert investigation and approvals
milestones.summary: Local synthetic alert investigation and separate implementation/publication approvals have recorded passing tests with simulated APIs and SDK responses. Hosted metadata observations passed for new, edited, and restored comments, including prior-report archive authentication. Phase 4 acceptance remains pending.
limitations: The hosted deleted-comment observation failed. A narrow unavailable-comment correction passed local tests; hosted requalification remains pending.
An unavailable comment does not prove deletion or grant approval.
Local tests do not establish hosted alert investigation, protected SDK repair, or draft PR publication. No hosted engineering approval lifecycle is qualified.
Automatic event forwarding, issue creation, production telemetry, live-model qualification, merge, and deployment remain outside the demonstrated Phase 4 scope.
